line.text: On the desk of the music stand, in the dust, a tuning fork. Steel, stamped, older than the last refit.
It is engraved, badly, by hand, with a knife rather than a tool: A=444.
You strike it on your knee and hold it up, the way you have ten thousand times, and it gives you A.
